questions.cardDe: Wie heißt das spanische Festival, das in Ernest Hemingways Roman Fiesta eine Rolle spielt?
questions.de: Wie heißt das spanische Festival, das in Ernest Hemingways Roman Fiesta eine Rolle spielt?
questions.en: What is the name of the Spanish festival that features in Ernest Hemingway's novel The Sun Also Rises (Fiesta)?
questions.answerDe: Sanfermines (Fiesta de San Fermín in Pamplona)

timeline.labelEn: Ernest Hemingway's novel “The Sun Also Rises” (German: “Fiesta”) is published
timeline.labelDe: Ernest Hemingways Roman „Fiesta“ („The Sun Also Rises“) erscheint

questions.notes: Held annually in Pamplona from 6 to 14 July, famous for the running of the bulls (encierro).
